instant.$description:
Status: Experimental. Unit: milliseconds. Immediate state change with no perceptible transition. Use for reduced or non-animated changes when continuity is unnecessary.
Reduced motion mode: transitions collapse to 0 ms and linear reference to avoid non-essential motion.

fast.$description:
Status: Experimental. Unit: milliseconds. Micro-interactions and immediate feedback such as hover, pressed and small visual responses.
Reduced motion mode: transitions collapse to 0 ms and linear reference to avoid non-essential motion.

moderate.$description:
Status: Experimental. Unit: milliseconds. Default transition duration for common component state changes and compact UI movement.
Reduced motion mode: transitions collapse to 0 ms and linear reference to avoid non-essential motion.

slow.$description:
Status: Experimental. Unit: milliseconds. Larger transitions, overlays and changes that need stronger visual continuity.
Reduced motion mode: transitions collapse to 0 ms and linear reference to avoid non-essential motion.

deliberate.$description:
Status: Experimental. Unit: milliseconds. Reserved for meaningful entrances, exits or complex transitions. Avoid for frequent interactions.
Reduced motion mode: transitions collapse to 0 ms and linear reference to avoid non-essential motion.

continuous.$description: Duration for continuous indeterminate loops such as the Button loading spinner. Default: 800 ms. Reduced motion: 0 ms; the indicator remains static. DTCG type: duration.

linear.$description:
Status: Experimental. DTCG type: cubicBezier. Use for constant-rate motion such as indeterminate progress or continuous rotation. Not intended for standard interface state changes. Figma stores this as a reference string because native variables do not bind directly to prototype easing. Export mapping must convert the CSS string to the DTCG numeric array.
Reduced motion mode: transitions collapse to 0 ms and linear reference to avoid non-essential motion.

standard.$description:
Status: Experimental. DTCG type: cubicBezier. Default easing for interface state changes where an element remains in context. Figma stores this as a reference string because native variables do not bind directly to prototype easing. Export mapping must convert the CSS string to the DTCG numeric array.
Reduced motion mode: transitions collapse to 0 ms and linear reference to avoid non-essential motion.

enter.$description:
Status: Experimental. DTCG type: cubicBezier. Decelerating curve for elements entering or becoming visible. Figma stores this as a reference string because native variables do not bind directly to prototype easing. Export mapping must convert the CSS string to the DTCG numeric array.
Reduced motion mode: transitions collapse to 0 ms and linear reference to avoid non-essential motion.

exit.$description:
Status: Experimental. DTCG type: cubicBezier. Accelerating curve for elements leaving or becoming hidden. Figma stores this as a reference string because native variables do not bind directly to prototype easing. Export mapping must convert the CSS string to the DTCG numeric array.
Reduced motion mode: transitions collapse to 0 ms and linear reference to avoid non-essential motion.
